page_title: EMP 0-0 FIO | Empoli v Fiorentina 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) replaces Robin Gosens.
85' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Faustino Anjorin is replaced by Nicolas Haas (Empoli).
84' The ball possession at the moment is 35:65.
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Christian Kouame will be replaced by Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina).
79' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina), but it's just wide of the left post.
78' The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
78' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina). The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
76' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Sebastiano Esposito will be replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Empoli).
75' Here comes a substitution. Liam Henderson is given a rest as he is replaced by Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
73' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
72' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Substitution. Andrea Colpani walks off the pitch and Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) comes on as a substitute.
71' Substitution. Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) in, Danilo Cataldi out.
71' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) replaces Albert Gudmundsson.
69' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
69' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Fiorentina win a corner.
58' Substitution. Ola Solbakken (Empoli) has come on for Lorenzo Colombo.
58' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
54' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
50' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
48' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post.
46' The whistle blows and Gianluca Aureliano starts the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina).
43' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) brings an opponent down and Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game. Fiorentina have a free kick from a promising distance.
40' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
30' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the left post.
26' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
26' Fiorentina take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
25' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
19' A shot from the edge of the box by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
15' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
9' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
4' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
4' Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina win a corner kick.
3' Empoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

The players are out at last! Empoli will take the kick-off.
